en.t: Her mother had written from the capital.

units.source_text: 信中说道：“昨夜我做了一梦，看见你的模样异乎寻常。

en.t: In the letter she said, "Last night I had a dream and saw you looking strangely unlike yourself.

units.source_text: 今天正在各处寺院举办诵经祈祷。

en.t: Today I am having sutras recited and prayers offered at various temples.

units.source_text: 想是昨夜梦后不曾再睡之故，今天白昼想睡，睡后又得一梦，

en.t: Perhaps because I could not sleep again after last night's dream, I grew sleepy during the day today, and after falling asleep I had another dream,

units.source_text: 梦见你逢到世人所认为不祥之事。

en.t: in which I saw you meet with something that people would regard as ominous.
As soon as I woke, I wrote this letter to you.
Please, above all, be careful and keep this in mind.

units.source_text: 你的住处荒僻，薰大将时时赴访，他家二公主恐多怨气，

en.t: Your dwelling is lonely and remote, and since General Kaoru visits so often, the Second Princess of his household may be deeply resentful,
and if you were harmed by her curse, it would be terribly frightening.

units.source_text: 正当你身体不适之时，我做这种噩梦，实在非常担心。

en.t: At a time when you are unwell, having such a dreadful dream has made me deeply anxious.

units.source_text: 我很想到宇治来探望你，但你的妹妹产前疾病缠绵，似有鬼怪作祟。

en.t: I very much want to come to Uji to see you, but your younger sister has been ill for a long time before childbirth, as though some spirit were troubling her.

units.source_text: 我离开她片刻，常陆守就要严责，因此未能前来。

en.t: If I leave her even for a moment, the Governor of Hitachi scolds me severely, so I have been unable to come.

units.source_text: 希望你在附近寺院中也举办诵经祈祷。”

en.t: I hope you too will arrange for sutra recitations and prayers at a nearby temple."

units.source_text: 此外又附有各种布施物品及致僧侣的请托书。

en.t: In addition, she had enclosed various offerings and letters of request addressed to the monks.

units.source_text: 浮舟想道：“我命已到大限，母亲犹然不知，

en.t: Ukifune thought, "My life has already reached its end, yet my mother still does not know,

units.source_text: 说此关怀之语，实甚可悲！”

en.t: and for her to speak such words of concern is truly pitiful."

units.source_text: 便在派遣这使者赴寺院的期间写回信给母亲。

en.t: Then, while sending this messenger to the temple, she wrote a reply to her mother.

units.source_text: 欲说之事甚多，而无勇气走笔，只写了一首小诗：

en.t: There was much she wished to say, but she had no courage to let the brush move, and wrote only a short poem:
